notices.title: New update on the way, and it's a good one
notices.body:
Next update lands this week.

Fixed
• Renamed meters keep your name on the Lock Screen
• iCloud sync can't drop an account
• Hiding a meter updates History instantly
• Count-down shows "100% left", not a bug

New on the Mac
• As many meters as you like in the menu bar, side by side or stacked, each with its own icon or name
• A System Settings style layout (classic tabs still there)

Your turn
Want a feature, or found a bug? Now is the time: Settings, then Send feedback. Every message gets read.

notices.title: More from OpenRouter in the next update
notices.body: OpenRouter is about to get proper meters: spend today, this week and this month, your key's own total, and a heads-up before a key expires — not just a credit balance. Claude credits get a fix as well, so a spend limit you haven't set no longer shows as a permanent 0%. Coming shortly.

notices.title: Some meters missing from the Main focus list
notices.body: The update just released introduced a bug but is being fixed right now: switching a meter off under Focus > Also show on Lock Screen also removes it from the Main focus list, so choices like Session (5 hr) can go missing. Sorry to anyone this caught out. Until the fix arrives you can still change your focus in Settings > Live Activity > Focus meter, which always lists every meter.

notices.title: A new unnamed meter may appear for Claude accounts
notices.body: Anthropic has switched on a hidden usage bucket that some Claude accounts now report, so an unfamiliar meter at 0% may have appeared on your dashboard. It is not a bug, and your real meters are unaffected. We do not yet know what it is. A fix has already been submitted to Apple and is awaiting review, which can take some time. It hides unannounced meters until they show real usage, and adds a setting to reveal them early, so brand new models still appear between app updates.
